descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The most realistic quarterback training experience in VR.

Step into the pocket on Meta Quest 3 and train like a real QB. Read the field, work your progressions, and deliver true-to-football throws with authentic spin, touch, and timing. Every rep sharpens your throw motion - load, separation, release angle, velocity, and consistency - so what you build in VR transfers to the field.

Built with pro QB trainer Mike Giovando, Elev8 turns reps into results:

- Game-like drills for accuracy, reads, arm strength, and pocket movement
- True-to-football ball physics that reward clean mechanics
- Full-body tracked avatar for realistic footwork and throw motion
- Next Gen-style stats after every drill, so you see what's improving and what's slipping
- Adjustable difficulty for quick sessions or deep practice

Whether you're a youth quarterback, a high school starter, or a coach looking for an edge between sessions, Elev8 Academy VR helps you get more high-quality reps than the field alone allows. Use it between in-person sessions to stay locked into your coaching points and track measurable improvement over time.

Snap. Read. Throw. Elev8 your game.
